control_settings.description: General control settings for this tool

aircraft_exchange_file_name.description: Specify the name of the exchange file

aircraft_exchange_file_directory.description: Specify the direction in which the aircraft exchange file can be found

own_tool_level.description: Specify the tool level of this tool

console_output.description: Selector to specify the console output ('mode_0': Off, 'mode_1': only out/err/warn, 'mode_2': 1 + info, 'mode_3': 2 + debug)

log_file_output.description: Selector to specify the log file output ('mode_0': Off, 'mode_1': only out/err/warn, 'mode_2': 1 + info, 'mode_3': 2 + debug)

plot_output.description: Specify the way plotting shall be handled

enable.description: Switch to enable plotting ('true': On, 'false': Off)

copy_plotting_files.description: Switch if plotting files shall be copied ('true': On, 'false': Off)

delete_plotting_files_from_tool_folder.description: Switch if plotting files shall be deleted from folder ('true': On, 'false': Off)

report_output.description: Switch to generate an HTML report ('true': On, 'false': Off)

tex_report.description: Switch to generate a Tex report ('true': On, 'false': Off)

write_info_files.description: Switch to generate info files ('true': On, 'false': Off)

gnuplot_script.description: Specify the name of the plot file

log_file.description: Specify the name of the log file

inkscape_path.description: Path to the inkscape application ('DEFAULT': Use inkscape from the UNICADO repo structure)

gnuplot_path.description: Path to the gnuplot application ('DEFAULT': Use gnuplot from the UNICADO repo structure)

conversionDirection.description: Selection of the conversion direction. Selector: mode_0(UNICADO2CPACS) / mode_1(CPACS2UNICADO)

mission_selection.description: Selection of the mission. design_mission / study_mission

cpacs_file_name.description: Name of the file to convert

UNICADO2CPACS.description: Sets settings for UNICADO2CPACS (Only if conversionDirection=0)

xml_blocks.description: Selection of the XML blocks to be read from UNICADO-XML and translated to CPACS.

general.description: Convert General from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

masses.description: Convert masses from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

geometry.description: Convert complete aircraft geometry from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

wing_geometry.description: Convert wing geometry from UNICADO to CPACS in case WriteGeometry=0? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

stabilizer_geometry.description: Convert stabilizer geometry from UNICADO to CPACS in case WriteGeometry=0? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

landing_gear_geometry.description: Display Landing gear struts?(CPACS 3+) Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

accommodation.description: Convert accommodation from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

propulsion.description: Convert propulsion from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

systems.description: Convert systems from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

aerodynamics.description: Convert aerodynamics from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

stability_control.description: Convert Stability and Control characteristics from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

performance.description: Convert Mission and trajectory from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

monetary_values.description: Convert monetary values from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

ecological_values.description: Convert ecological values from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

requirements.description: Convert requirements from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

design_specifications.description: Convert design specifications from UNICADO to CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)

delete_empty_uID_trees.description: Should empty uID-trees be deleted in CPACS? Switch: true (yes) / false (no)
